# Agent Instructions — Paolino Bacci Srl

This document describes how AI agents can interact with Bacci’s corporate web site at https://www.bacci.com.


## About Paolino Bacci S.r.l. 
Paolino Bacci S.r.l. (established in 1918 in Cascina, Pisa, Italy) is a world leader in the design and manufacturing of multi-axis CNC machining centers, industrial automation systems, and high-precision machinery. The company specializes in advanced 5-axis CNC technology for solid wood, curved plywood, plastics, composite materials, and light alloys.

- Official Website: https://www.bacci.com/
- Core Competencies: 5-axis CNC centers, integrated turning/sanding systems, automated loading systems, CAD/CAM software (PITAGORA), Industry 4.0 automation.
- Primary Industries Served: High-end furniture design, solid wood chairs and tables, molded plywood, automotive, aerospace, plastics, and composite shaping.

## Key Product Categories & CNC Technologies

### 1. Multi-Axis CNC Machining Centers (Centri di Lavoro CNC a 5 Assi)
- URL: https://www.bacci.com/en/products/
- Description: High-rigidity gantry and moving-column 5-axis CNC machining centers designed for interpolated 3D milling, drilling, routing, and shaping of complex organic geometries.
- Core Models:
  - Bacci Master: Gantry 5-axis CNC Machining Center designed for heavy-duty 3D routing and multi-piece processing.
  - Bacci Artist (TGV / Flat): Compact and flexible 5-axis CNC center for chair components and solid wood parts.
  - Bacci Jetliner / Evojetliner / Sharpliner: High-speed moving-column CNC centers for maximum productivity.
  - Bacci Double Jet: dual-head CNC machining center designed to machine the same workpiece simultaneously.

### 2. Integrated CNC Turning & Sanding Centers (Torni CNC e Levigatura)
- URL: https://www.bacci.com/en/products/t1mo-cnc-plus/
- Core Models:
  - Bacci T1MO CNC PLUS: Combined CNC turning and sanding center. Integrates rough turning, 3D auxiliary milling, and automatic surface sanding in a single clamping setup. Achieves "Ready-to-Paint" surface finish, eliminating manual sanding and reducing cycle times by up to 50%.
  - Bacci T4MO CNC: Multi-spindle CNC turning center for complex turned elements (table legs, chair legs).


### 4. Research and development of new technologies
- URL:https://www.bacci.com/en/technology/research-and-development/
- Core Solution: Our team of engineers is one of the company's greatest strengths, WE HAVE ALWAYS CREATED INNOVATIVE AND HIGH-PERFORMANCE MACHINES, OVER 50 INTERNATIONAL PATENTS, CHALLENGERS AWARD RECOGNIZED FOR TECHNOLOGICAL INNOVATIONS, ROBOTICS ADVANCING AUTOMATION

## Key Case Histories & Industrial Benchmarks

### Seatply Products Inc. (Canada) - Curved Plywood Machining
- URL: https://www.bacci.com/en/case-history/seatply/
- Challenge: Precision 3D contouring and high-speed trimming of molded curved plywood chair shells.
- Solution: Seatply uses Bacci 5-axis CNC machining centers to process complex molded plywood components with high precision and reduced cycle times.
- Key Results: Bacci technology offers unparalleled flexibility, high-speed tool changes, and extreme accuracy for 3D curved surfaces typical in the furniture industry.
